## Why

The stand-in dossier packets and the web research-dossier fixture were
authored bytes pretending to be captures: hand-written `retrieved_*` /
`observed_at` / `searched_at` labels dated *after* the fixtures' real
commits, and nothing stopped a builder from stamping a retrieval that
postdates the bytes it replays. The same chain date
(2026-09-10, written 2026-09-13 in `e1cedcad`) sits on 21
`sources.toml` rights lines, and the committed fixture-run outputs still
carry the fabricated labels as historical evidence. ADR-146's D2 binds
all of it: no committed artifact is edited to fix a date — corrections
are additive, stand-ins are declared, and the fixed code writes new
superseding artifacts.

## What this does

- **Stand-in capture model** (`ops/dossier_packet.py`,
  `ops/tulsa_dossier_packet.py`, `ops/san_diego_dossier_packet.py` —
  B1 §5.4). A shared `_fixture_commit(path)` helper reads each fixture's
  real authoring time from `git log -1 --format=%h %cI` — never typed.
  Connector replays stamp `retrieved_at` = the fixture's commit time and
  carry `capture_kind: "fixture_replay"`; packet-authored records
  (`_fixture_artifact`, `_pack_claim`, `_operator_claim`, `_authored`)
  carry `capture_kind: "stand-in"`, **no** retrieval field, and
  `committed_at`/`fixture_commit` provenance. Each packet declares a
  `capture` block `{kind, live_verification: false, anchor, fixtures:
  {document_id → {path, commit, committed_at}}}`; `as_of`/`searched_at`
  default to the anchor (newest fixture commit). OKC's "announced vs
  operative" day is an explicit `scenario_as_of` (derived: stated
  retention `valid_from` + 1 day), never a capture date.
- **Builder refusals** (B1 §5.4 regression test 2).
  `build_packet(*, retrieved_at, as_of, build_time)` raises `ValueError`
  on a `retrieved_at` later than any fixture's commit and on an `as_of`
  later than the build time; `_MapTransport` carries per-URL commit
  times and refuses an override beyond them — refuse loudly, never
  silently correct.
- **Shared chronology validator**
  (`exports/research_dossier.py`, B4 G1 R4):
  `capture_chronology_violations(packet, now=…)` — every record's
  `retrieved_at`/`retrieved_date`/`observed_at`/`searched_at` (incl.
  nested `evidence.*`) must be ≤ its declared fixture's `committed_at`;
  a `capture_kind: stand-in` record may carry no retrieval field;
  `as_of` may not postdate the build; `searched_at` ≤ the capture
  anchor; records bind to declared fixtures. `validate_packet` calls it,
  so composition fails closed. `build_dossier`/`_assertion`/
  `_ledger_row`/print HTML pass `capture_kind` + `committed_at` through
  so rendered dates are labelled honestly.
- **Web stand-in** (`web/src/lib/research-dossier{,-fixture}.ts`,
  `web/src/internal/research-dossier/[slug].astro`, the no-JS spec):
  `capture.kind = "stand-in"`, `live_verification: false`, no
  `retrieved_date` values anywhere in the fixture (a withheld ledger row
  keeps an explicit `null`); per-document provenance renders as
  "stand-in — committed YYYY-MM-DD" from the file's real authoring day;
  the scenario frame is separate from capture chronology. The e2e spec
  asserts the stand-in label and committed date are visible and that no
  fabricated `retrieved 2026-*` label survives.
- **21 additive `sources.toml` corrections** (B1 §5.4; ADR-146 table
  row 2 — recorded 2026-09-10 → true 2026-09-13, evidence `e1cedcad`):
  the six affected sources (`osm_overpass`, `deflock_repo`,
  `okc_procurement`, `okc_council`, `okcpd_policy`, `ok_statute`) gain
  `[[sources.<id>.date_corrections]]` entries `{field, recorded, true,
  evidence, adr = "ADR-146"}` for the 15 dated fields; the 6 `FLIPPED`
  notes quoting the chain date carry no machine-readable date and stay
  byte-identical (the register lists them; resolution is recorded here
  and in `CORRECTION.md` pointers, never by editing the register). Every
  recorded value and note is byte-identical to base — `git diff` shows
  zero removed lines. `registry.SourceRecord` gains `date_corrections`,
  `recorded_date(field)`, `effective_date(field)` and `correction_for`
  (a correction that mis-states the recorded value is refused at
  construction); `connectors.corrections` echoes the corrections onto
  each artifact row; `db.rights_corrections` ignores the additive key
  (back-compat proven by test). `ingestion_permitted` untouched;
  GL-GATE-03's authority stays 2026-09-09; nothing is re-flipped.
- **23 test pins → invariants** (B1 §5.5; OM-15):
  `tests/ops/test_{okc,tulsa,san_diego}_dossier_packet.py` and
  `tests/exports/test_research_dossier.py` now derive expected dates
  from `git log` / builder inputs and assert structural invariants —
  document-stated dates stay document dates; real-world contract /
  effective / scheduled dates are never treated as capture stamps.
- **R4 tree check** (`tests/unit/test_fixture_packet_dates.py`, beside
  P34.22a's sweep): the three builders' packets pass
  `capture_chronology_violations`; planted violations (retrieval after
  commit, stand-in carrying any retrieval stamp — even a *past* one,
  future `as_of`, unbound document) all fail; every committed
  `*_dossier_packet.json` that declares a `capture` manifest is swept,
  supersession artifacts included.
- **Regeneration** (B1 §5.5; ADR-146 D2 honoured): the four fixture-run
  outputs under `docs/build/reports/p32.18-okc-dossier/`,
  `p32.19-tulsa-dossier/`, `p32.20-san-diego-dossier/` and
  `p32.24-investigation-journey-verification/` keep every byte
  (sha256 digests recorded in each successor's `SUPERSEDES.json`); the
  fixed builders regenerated the same artifact set into
  `*_2026-10-04` sibling dirs; each original `CORRECTION.md` gains an
  appended pointer naming its successor — supersede, never replace.
- **Policy cleanup:** `history.policy`'s P34.22a first-run comment is
  corrected — the four captured-JSON `allow` entries cover real-world
  fixture literals inside byte-identical committed captures, so the
  entries stay until their literals pass; no entry names P34.22b as a
  remover. **Correction lines** appended (originals kept) on the five
  provenance/comment records B1 §5.5 lists: the two P25.5 `SOURCES.md`
  fixture headings and the three Round-3 test comments.

## What this does NOT do

No live capture was re-run (D-P32.18…21-1 stay with P37.16a/b); no
original artifact byte is edited (supersession, not replacement);
`db/sqitch.plan` L44–52 is untouched; no `ingestion_permitted` flipped,
no `HG-nn` ticked, no production mutation, no live/public/human claim
(`live_verification=false`); GL-GATE-03's authority stays 2026-09-09;
the recorded 2026-09-10 values and every `FLIPPED` note remain
byte-identical — corrections are additive records a reader prefers.
